items.title: Eddie Miller and Pete Fountain Interview, 1970-01-09
items.q: Well, Guy Lombardo's all hang out, isn't it?

ctx.x: No, they were playing at the Roosevelt Grill, I think, now they, I think they open in Vegas on the 15th of this month.
Well, Guy Lombardo's all hang out, isn't it?
I understand there's a chance that band may come back to Al Hurt's club soon. That's what I heard, yes.
